## Hinge question · Finding a term {#ss5-hinge .gp-lesson .sequence-hinge .gp-hinge}

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">A geometric sequence has <span data-math="a_1=2">a₁ = 2</span> and <span data-math="a_2=6">a₂ = 6</span>. Find <span data-math="a_5">a₅</span>.</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="18">18</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="81">81</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="162">162</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="486">486</span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> <span data-math="r=\frac62=3">r = 6/2 = 3</span><br><span data-math="a_5=2\times3^{5-1}=162">a₅ = 2 × 3⁴ = 162</span></div>
</div>
```

::: notes

Use the default 60-second adjustable timer and simultaneous 1–4 finger routine. Timer expiry does not reveal the answer. Correct answer 3: r=6/2=3, a_5=2×3^4=162. Choice 1 gives 18 by treating the sequence as arithmetic, a_5=2+4(6−2). Choice 2 gives 81 by omitting the first-term factor: 3^4. Choice 4 gives 486 by using exponent n rather than n−1: 2×3^5. Ready: ask students to explain the four multiplications and proceed. Divided: compare r with d and re-poll. Reteach: list 2,6,18,54,162 with indices 1–5 before returning to the formula. Reset clears choice, answer and timer.

:::
